stats.text:
Initiative determines the order of turns during combat. The combat rules in "Playing the Game" explain how to roll Initiative.

Sometimes a GM might have combatants use their Initiative scores instead of rolling Initiative. Your Initiative score equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier. If you have {ref:glossary/advantage} on Initiative rolls, increase your Initiative score by 5. If you have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on those rolls, decrease that score by 5. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("Combat").
